original_goal:
[Module: Product Detail | TC-007 | Type: Edge/State | Priority: Medium]
Title: Rapid double-click Add to cart when NotInCart does not duplicate cart entry (Edge/State | Medium)

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/product-detail.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "initial_product_state": "InCart"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Product Detail page for a product. Verification snapshot shows the product is currently InCart (Remove button present).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Verify the page shows the Remove button (product currently InCart)
  2. Click the Remove button to change the product state to NotInCart
  3. Verify the Add to cart button is visible
  4. Click the Add to cart button
  5. Immediately click the Add to cart button again (rapid second click)
  6. Navigate to the Shopping Cart

Expected Result:
  First click succeeds; product is added once; Shopping Cart lists exactly one instance of the product; Product Detail shows Remove; no duplicate entries or errors.

Notes from prior verification:
  Steps 1-3 were rewritten because the verification snapshot showed no Add to cart button (only Remove). To exercise the intended rapid-add flow we first remove the product (using the available Remove button) to reach NotInCart, then perform the rapid double-click Add to cart sequence. This change was necessary because the Add to cart element was not present initially.
expected_outcome: First click succeeds; product is added once; Shopping Cart lists exactly one instance of the product; Product Detail shows Remove; no duplicate entries or errors.
